stage0065_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's right.
　I'll show you how powerless you are.」

stage0065_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch...!
　Real confident, taking us on 2-on-1!」

stage0065_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... pull up data on his unit.」

stage0065_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アル$$
「A Series-D prototype unit, same as the Type-M.
　Specs show little change from the current Series-E.」

stage0065_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Come to think of it, I never introduced myself.
　Transferred in from the Mediterranean Fleet,
　Lieutenant $$ベルファンガン・クルーゾー$$.」

stage0065_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「As of today, I've been assigned to the
　West Pacific Fleet's $$ＳＲＴ$$, and to $c.」

stage0065_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Callsign's $$ウルズ$$ 1.
　Which makes me your team leader.」

stage0065_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$宗介$$
「So you're Captain $$マッカラン$$'s successor...」

stage0065_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「Is it okay not to stop this, $$マオ$$?」

stage0065_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マオ$$
「Just leave him be.
　It's basically his way of saying hello.」

stage0065_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't think it was, really.」

stage0065_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「At the very least, his skill is real.
　After all, he made it here alone,
　through Amalgam's encirclement.」

stage0065_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$刹那$$
「It's two on one, but this match...
　there's no telling how it'll go.」

stage0065_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Especially not with $$宗介$$ as he is now.」

stage0065_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「$$スザク$$...
　How do you see this match?」

stage0065_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スザク$$
「And if this keeps up, $$宗介$$...
　will die, eventually...」

stage0065_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The gallery's growing impatient.
　Let's get this started.」

stage0065_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Bring it!
　Once the bell rings, rank doesn't matter!」

stage0065_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Your read on the situation is naive.」

stage0065_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't go deciding that on your own!」

stage0065_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Still don't get it, huh...」

stage0065_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Time's up.
　I've gauged your strength.」

stage0065_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't go deciding that on your own!」

stage0065_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Still don't get it, huh...」

stage0065_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Here I come, Sergeant Sagara!
　Try and dodge this!」

stage0065_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「As expected, the Lambda Driver didn't activate.」

stage0065_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$イアン$$
「Speaking as an engineer,
　I'd say reliability, working without fail
　when it counts, is a weapon's lifeblood.」

stage0065_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$イアン$$
「Well, mind you, I'm the one who
　foisted that Twin Drive thing on $$刹那$$
　once, myself...」

stage0065_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you saying the Arbalest is defective?」

stage0065_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$イアン$$
「That's not what I'm saying.
　If anything, I feel the romance in it.」

stage0065_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$イアン$$
「I feel it holds potential beyond just being a weapon.
　In that sense, it's close in image to
　the GN Drive or the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.」

stage0065_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「The problem is, $$宗介$$ himself, the one
　piloting it, despises the Lambda Driver.」

stage0065_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$イアン$$
「He's a soldier through and through.
　He probably sees the Arbalest with a harsher
　eye than I do, and I'm the engineer.」

stage0065_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Ugly... truly ugly.
　Clumsy, forceful, without a shred of give.」

stage0065_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Get up, Sergeant!
　Draw out everything that machine has!
　Do you understand? Everything!」

stage0065_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$宗介$$
「Everything...
　The Lambda Driver, is it...」

stage0065_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So, in the end, he's just a lapdog...」

stage0065_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$マオ$$
「Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, heads up.
　A unit believed to be Amalgam is inbound.」

stage0065_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What, what is this!?
　I'm heartbroken!」

stage0065_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I heard you were having a falling-out,
　and I wanted a front-row seat...」

stage0065_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I even brought popcorn and cola,
　what am I supposed to do with it now!」

stage0065_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well, guess I'll just chug the cola!」

stage0065_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, launch!
　Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, $$クルツ$$, $$宗介$$,
　regroup and reset!」

stage0065_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like $$五飛$$ and A21 aren't here.」

stage0065_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a bit of a relief, then.」

stage0065_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$トロワ$$
「But careful.
　That AS out front... it's not normal.」

stage0065_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That too.
　But also exactly what I said.」

stage0065_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That type gives off a distinct feeling.」

stage0065_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I agree with $$トロワ$$.
　Put simply, that guy is abnormal.」

stage0065_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「In short, it means someone like $$ＡＧ$$ is piloting it.」

stage0065_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I wish I still didn't understand...」

stage0065_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Weber, fall back and support me.
　Sagara, disrupt the enemy solo.」

stage0065_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on!
　You just beat him half to death, and now
　you want Sousuke to keep fighting!?」

stage0065_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I held back.
　He should still be able to fight.」

stage0065_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buuurp!
　You kept me waiting so long, I burped!」

stage0065_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Sorry, kittens.
　This old man just can't help himself.」

stage0065_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Tch! No sense of fun!
　Here it's 'Oh, Master $$ゲイツ$$, how dreamy～!'
　Or 'Master $$ゲイツ$$, hold me～!' isn't it...」

stage0065_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ahh, this is boring, so I'll
　just wipe them all out real quick!」

stage0065_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Especially that white one, it looks worth crushing.」

stage0065_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well then, here we go, $c!
　The fun, fun party's starting!!」

stage0065_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Not bad...
　Seems like I've got an opponent
　I can enjoy for a while.」

stage0065_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Mom and the church priest were right!
　The world's not so bad after all!」

stage0065_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This is bad!
　Chugging that cola sent my gut into a nosedive!」

stage0065_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Even if I win, soiling my pants ruins it all!
　I'm out!」

stage0065_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buhahaha!
　$$ミスリル$$'s little treasure isn't so tough, huh!」

stage0065_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ah! I know you!
　You're the Knight of Zero, aren't you!」

stage0065_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$スザク$$
「I won't let you... touch $$宗介$$!」

stage0065_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buhahaha, this is priceless!
　The mighty Knight of Zero, protecting some
　grubby mercenary, kneeling before me!」

stage0065_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ahh!
　I laughed so hard my jaw and abs hurt!
　I'm heading home today!」

stage0065_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's as far as you go!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0065_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Buhahaha!
　$$ミスリル$$'s little treasure isn't so tough, huh!」

stage0065_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ahh!
　I laughed so hard my jaw and abs hurt!
　I'm heading home today!」

stage0065_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's as far as you go!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0065_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キリコ$$, look at the lead AT!」

stage0065_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Untouchable one, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...
　The day I settle things with you will come.」

stage0065_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カトル$$
「The captain's unit is falling back.」

stage0065_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So today was just reconnaissance, was it?」

stage0065_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（So she just came to see $$キリコ$$'s face...）

stage0065_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That woman... the one who took $$キリコ$$'s girl?」

stage0065_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Looks like $$マーティアル$$'s finally starting
　to move for real, teamed up with Amalgam.」

stage0065_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept $$マーティアル$$'s AT squad!
　Take them down fast and pull out of here!」

stage0065_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$マーティアル$$... god of war...
　Why come after me...）

stage0065_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Confirmed: Amalgam and $$マーティアル$$ wiped out.」

stage0065_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「So even $$マーティアル$$'s finally moving for real.
　This is gonna get troublesome.」

stage0065_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But there were also people who wanted this.」

stage0065_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, fall back.
　We're leaving this area before pursuers arrive.」

stage0065_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$玉芳$$
「Unable to continue combat.
　$$夏玉芳$$, falling back.」

stage0065_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$玉芳$$
「Unable to continue combat.
　$$夏玉芳$$, falling back.」

stage0065_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$玉芳$$
（$$玉蘭$$... the rest, as planned...）

stage0065_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「Can't go on any further.
　I'm heading back.」

stage0065_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$玉芳$$
（$$玉蘭$$... leave the rest to me.）

stage0065_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「Can't go on any further.
　I'm heading back.」

stage0065_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Our power's even... and your skill's not bad, either.
　But...!」

stage0065_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Just as I thought, a second-rate pilot.
　Your fighting has skill, but no art to it.
　...Do you understand the difference?」

stage0065_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Words won't get through to you after all.
　Then you'll simply have to feel it in your body...!」

stage0065_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Relax, Lieutenant!
　I'll leave your cockpit intact, out of mercy!」

stage0065_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Do you have room to worry about others?
　Not when you miss a punch at point-blank range.」

stage0065_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't mess with me!
　Through my scope, I never miss!
　I'll teach you that in your bones!」

stage0065_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
（Captain $$マッカラン$$... forgive my rudeness.）

stage0065_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
（Having taken over the $$ウルズ$$ 1 code from you,
　I will raise them to greater heights, without fail.）

stage0065_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Found you, white one!
　Quite the beauty, just like the rumors said!」

stage0065_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is this guy just toying around!?」

stage0065_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アル$$
「Warning.
　Enemy AS is running the Lambda Driver.
　Recommend activating our own system.」

stage0065_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What's wrong, what's wrong, gorgeous!
　Let's you and I get real close, huh!」

stage0065_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$玉芳$$
（$$相良宗介$$...
　I'll be his opponent.）

stage0065_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$玉芳$$
（All of this, for sensei's sake.）

stage0065_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$玉蘭$$
（$$相良宗介$$...
　I'll be the one to kill him.）

stage0065_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$玉蘭$$
（All of this, for sensei's sake.）

stage0065_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「No touching allowed!?
　So uptight, Miss $$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

stage0065_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Play along, come on!
　Otherwise $$ゲイツ$$ just looks like a clown here!」

stage0065_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「So you're $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$!
　Glad to meet a celebrity!」

stage0065_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh, the silent treatment! Ignoring me, huh!
　Didn't your mom teach you bullying's wrong!?」

stage0065_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Fine, I get it!
　For guys like you, it's payback times 100!
　$$ゲイツ$$ transforms from bullied to bully in style!」

stage0065_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Found a rare one!
　Gotcha, Innovator!」

stage0065_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Whoa! What's with you!
　All fired up in battle but can't hold a talk!」

stage0065_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$刹那$$
（Can I ever understand a man like this...）

stage0065_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Argh! Evil spirits, begone!
　Back to hell with you, wretched soul!」

stage0065_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unfortunate, indeed.
　As long as some wish for miracles, $$ゼロ$$ is immortal.」

stage0065_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What!?
　You think something that unreasonable is allowed!?」

stage0065_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Then allow me to teach you.
　The word 'immortal' suits nothing more
　than these sideburns of $$ゲイツ$$'s!」

stage0065_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now that's cool!
　Black's a man's dandyism, ain't it!」

stage0065_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Oh... you understand my taste, do you.」

stage0065_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But a true man cares about sideburns!
　Anyone who doesn't get that is third-rate, at best!」

stage0065_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Let me retract what I just said.
　It seems we're simply incompatible after all.」

stage0065_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A gravelly-voiced man obsessed with vulgar
　sideburns and stubble offends my aesthetics!」

stage0065_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hm! Hmm!
　I sense a cutie nearby!」

stage0065_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This is $$ゲイツ$$'s own sideburn sensor!
　I sense a sly, sexy vixen in that cockpit!」

stage0065_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$n
「This man... he's dangerous, no doubt about it!
　I'll take care of guys like him, quick!」

stage0065_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hey, hey!
　Don't treat $$ゲイツ$$ like some random mook!」

stage0065_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$マーティアル$$...
　$$フィアナ$$'s there too...）

stage0065_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$キリコ$$
（If I take these guys down, can I get $$フィアナ$$ back...）
